relations.subject: sgw:disaster-recovery-cluster
relations.evidence: (XDCR) replicates data between two or more autonomous Couchbase Server clusters. It plays an important role in supporting Disaster Recovery (DR) and Data Migration, even where Sync Gateway is the normal replicator of choice for mobile data.

relations.subject: xdcr:active-active-with-app-services
relations.evidence: This model provides zero-downtime disaster recovery using bi-directional XDCR between two active mobile clusters. This requires running Sync Gateway 4.0+ on both sides of the active-active XDCR setup.

relations.subject: xdcr:active-active-with-app-services
relations.evidence: You must configure both clusters with `import_docs=true`.

relations.subject: sgw:disaster-recovery-cluster
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (promoted requiresPriorExecutionOf) - the optional index pre-initialization step must happen, if used at all, before unidirectional XDCR begins
relations.evidence: Temporarily reconfigure the Sync Gateway cluster to connect to the Disaster Recovery cluster with the database in offline mode (`offline: true` in the database configuration) so that indexes are built asynchronously.

relations.subject: sgw:disaster-recovery-cluster
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (promoted renamedFrom) - in the active-active model the former Primary is stated to become the new DR cluster automatically, a role relabeling rather than a data operation
relations.evidence: The original primary becomes the new DR cluster automatically and requires no manual XDCR reconfiguration.

notable_absence.finding: For the two non-active-active DR models ('Clusters in Same Region' and 'Clusters in Different Regions'), activation involves the SAME role swap stated in near-identical language twice: 'Make the Disaster Recovery cluster the new Primary cluster, and make the old Primary cluster the new Disaster Recovery.' Unlike the active-active model's automatic swap (captured above via renamedFrom), this swap is a MANUAL administrative step in both other models - the same underlying fact (roles relabel, no data moves) recurs three times on this page under three different amounts of automation, and no page distinguishes 'automatic relabeling' from 'manual relabeling' as a named axis.

cross_component_finding: All three DR models in this page rely on the SAME optional optimization (pre-initializing/pre-building Sync Gateway's own GSI indexes on the DR cluster before failover) to avoid the exact index-rebuild latency problem this batch's indexing.md and index-partitions.md describe from the configuration side - a concrete example of index-partitions.json's Zero-Downtime migration guidance and this page's DR activation guidance solving the same underlying problem (avoiding an index rebuild on a live-traffic switch) in two different operational contexts.
cross_product_finding: The reused xdcr:active-active-with-app-services concept was originally promoted from a Couchbase Server procedural page (server/current/manage/manage-xdcr/create-xdcr-replication.md) plus two Capella pages, with the note that it is 'assembled from a Server procedure page and two Capella pages - no single page states all three legs.' This Sync-Gateway-side page adds a fourth, independent leg: it restates the same Sync Gateway 4.0+ / bi-directional XDCR requirement from the mobile-deployment side, entirely without reference to the Server or Capella pages that originally established the concept.
